id: \bWallace: Hello there. I was in the middle of training. Did you find any of it elegant?
en: \bWallace: Hello there. I was in the middle of training. Did you find any of it elegant?
it: \bAdriano: Salve. Mi stavo allenando. Hai trovato qualcosa di elegante nei miei movimenti?

id: \bWhat's that? They want me down at the contest hall. I suppose I'll head out.
en: \bWhat's that? They want me down at the contest hall. I suppose I'll head out.
it: \bCome dici? Mi vogliono alla sala delle gare. Credo che andrò.

id: \bActually, you seem like you take good care of your Pokémon. Might I suggest you enter the Wallace Cup? I expect you'll do great.
en: \bActually, you seem like you take good care of your Pokémon. Might I suggest you enter the Wallace Cup?  I expect you'll do great.
it: \bA dire il vero, sembri prenderti molta cura dei tuoi Pokémon. Posso suggerirti di partecipare alla Coppa Adriano? Sono certo che te la caverai benissimo.

id: \bI guess we can fly you around. Where are we going?
en: \bI guess we can fly you around. Where are we going?
it: \bSuppongo che possiamo portarti in volo. Dove andiamo?
